subject.title: fix(whatsapp): cache bot's own outbound messages for quote metadata (#91445)

question: Should this PR stay blocked until redacted live WhatsApp Desktop/group proof is attached, or may maintainer-owned validation override the contributor proof gate?
rationale: The source fix is narrow and dependency-backed, but the reported failure is a visible WhatsApp Desktop rendering behavior that unit tests cannot fully prove.

options.title: Require Desktop Proof First
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or live validation transcript showing a real WhatsApp Desktop/group reply bubble after swipe-replying to a bot-authored message.

options.title: Accept Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can independently validate the Desktop group flow and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged, or close it in favor of a maintainer-tested replacement, if no real WhatsApp proof can be produced.

recommendation.title: Require Desktop Proof First
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or live validation transcript showing a real WhatsApp Desktop/group reply bubble after swipe-replying to a bot-authored message.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the latest cleanup commit on the current PR head, so they are the best available owner for proof-gate intent.
